status: First production-direction slice for issue #4. Not a complete V1 asset set: see docs/design/asset-inventory.md for what is not produced.
generatedBy: design/tools/build-exports.mjs from design/source/export-recipes.json. Do not edit by hand.

conventions.units: SVG user units. One unit is one CSS pixel at the size given by width and height; every export scales freely.
conventions.coordinates: Anchors are in the export's own viewBox: x to the right, y down, origin at the top left.
conventions.filenames: <asset id>.<variant>.<first ten hex digits of the SHA-256 of the file>.svg. A changed file is a new name, so a file may be cached forever.
conventions.text: No export contains text. Every word on screen is live English text supplied by the client.
conventions.loading: What a device fetches must tell an observer nothing. A DOM client loads each bundle through its one stylesheet (bundles.<name>.stylesheet), before the first match view and whatever the seat's state: every variant is in it as a custom property named --ms-asset-<id>-<variant>, so nothing is fetched later. A client that fetches individual files (a scene loading textures) fetches all of a bundle or none of it, never a file because of something a view says.
conventions.scene: Proposed for the Three.js evaluation, not measured: +Y up, floor on X/Z, one authored unit is one grid unit, a token's origin is its floor contact. Stack order and depth on the Room A layers are a starting point to tune.
conventions.surfaces: table is the shared display. phone-public is a phone with its private sheet closed. phone-private is inside an open private sheet. An export may be drawn only on the surfaces it lists.
conventions.layers: A data-layer attribute names the source layer a group came from. Ids are kept only on definitions.

rights.origin: Original vector artwork drawn for this repository as hand-written SVG. No third-party artwork, font, stock asset, photograph, traced image or generated raster image is included or was used as a source.
rights.author: Visual and Motion Designer workstream, issue #4: a Claude Code session (model claude-opus-5-5) working for the game owner.
rights.license: None granted. The repository carries no distribution license.
rights.reuse: Use inside the Mothership project only. Any other use needs the game owner's decision (DSN-D06).

public-board.loadPolicy: The table display and every phone. Every device of this audience fetches this bundle's one stylesheet before the first match view, whatever the seat's role, state or turn. An individual file is never fetched because of something a view says: which files a device asks for must tell an observer nothing. Contains nothing that depends on a role, a faction or a private choice.

player-ui.loadPolicy: Every phone, identically. Every device of this audience fetches this bundle's one stylesheet before the first match view, whatever the seat's role, state or turn. An individual file is never fetched because of something a view says: which files a device asks for must tell an observer nothing.

roles.loadPolicy: UNIFORM. Every phone, identically, before roles are shown. Every device of this audience fetches this bundle's one stylesheet before the first match view, whatever the seat's role, state or turn. An individual file is never fetched because of something a view says: which files a device asks for must tell an observer nothing. Fetching one role's art by itself can disclose that role.

assets.title: Neutral numbered player token
assets.dataSource: One per seat in seats[]. The numeral is the seat number. Health variants follow seats[].health. Nothing else may change it.

assets.title: Token numerals 1 to 9
assets.dataSource: The seat number, 1 to 9. Never a count of anything else.

assets.title: Private token emphasis: rings and the dimmed token
assets.dataSource: PRIVATE, and drawn by no reference rule yet. Meant for a target list the server supplies (DSN-D03): may be chosen, chosen on this device, not offered. Protocol 1 has no such list, and a ring would claim one.

assets.title: Public health marker
assets.dataSource: seats[].health: Healthy, Injured or Eliminated. A separate fact from Jail and Captain.

assets.title: Public Jail marker
assets.dataSource: seats[].jailed is true. Jail is not a health state; a seat's location is a separate field.

assets.title: Public Captain marker
assets.dataSource: seats[].captain is true. It stays with the title when the Captain leaves Command Room and says nothing about immunity. A rank star, deliberately not a shield.

assets.title: Public active-turn marker
assets.dataSource: activeSeatId equals this seat. Public. Never drawn inside the private sheet.

assets.title: Own-seat marker
assets.dataSource: The seat equals the player view's audience.seatId. Drawn on that player's own phone only; the seat number itself is public.

assets.title: Public move: ink trail
assets.dataSource: A public-move cue, which needs a PUBLIC_MOVE event and a view that shows the seat in its new location.

anchors.alignTo: Bottom center sits on the top center of the landing token.
Bottom center sits on the top center of the landing token.

assets.title: Public move: landing puff
assets.dataSource: A public-move cue, as fx-ink-trail.

anchors.alignTo: The contact point sits on the token origin (floor contact).
The contact point sits on the token origin (floor contact).

assets.title: Round transition: panel sweep edge
assets.dataSource: A round-transition cue, which needs a PHASE_CHANGED event and a view whose round number went up.

anchors.alignTo: The left edge continues a plain block of the same color.
The left edge continues a plain block of the same color.

assets.title: Round transition: speed lines
assets.dataSource: A round-transition cue, as fx-panel-cap.

assets.title: Halftone tiles
assets.dataSource: Decoration. Shading only; it states nothing.

assets.title: Hatch tile
assets.dataSource: The pending band of an action card while its own command is being sent or checked, and the frame and banner edge that mark a stale view. It states nothing by itself.

assets.title: Shot action icon
assets.dataSource: The Shot action card inside the private sheet. The same for every seat shown the card.

assets.title: Private sheet closed and open
assets.dataSource: Whether the player has opened the private sheet on this device. Local state; closed by default.

assets.title: Stale connection icon
assets.dataSource: The client's own connection status is stale: the view shown is the last known one.

assets.title: Resource pip
assets.dataSource: PRIVATE. Drawn only from the player's own view: available from self.shotAvailable, registered while the seat's own command is listed in ownPendingCommandIds. Spent has no field in protocol 1 (DSN-D02).

assets.title: Officer role illustration
assets.dataSource: PRIVATE. The player view's self.role is Officer. Shown only inside that seat's open private sheet.

sprites.dataSource: The same symbols as the standalone public exports, for inline use with <use>.
sprites.use: Inline the file into the document once, then reference a symbol with <svg><use href="#<symbol>"/></svg>. Tintable symbols take the CSS color of the element that uses them.
